copy.headline: Freeze conditions expected across North Texas as colder air moves in ahead of Thanksgiving
copy.caption:

Expect a cloudy, chilly day with a chance of a few showers. Some sleet pellets may be possible across the far western counties.

story.title: Freeze conditions expected across North Texas as colder air moves in ahead of Thanksgiving
story.summary: Some sleet pellets may be possible across the far western counties. Definitely grab a jacket on your way out the door. November 24, 2026 / 6:05 AM CST / CBS Texas It's another cold start with an even colder night on the way Tuesday. Expect a cloudy, chilly day with a chance of a few showers. Some sleet pellets may be possible across the far western counties. Definitely grab a jacket on your way out the door. Looking ahead to Wednesday and Thursday mornings, temperatures will be at or below the freezing mark across most of the viewing area, and as a result, First Alert Weather Days are in place. Temperatures will be as cold as 25°, but across DFW it does look like temperatures will stay just above the freezing mark.
